meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Codex 设为主智能体,接替 Claude 做规划、调用工具并恢复历史会话。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望终端 AI 的规划与工具调度由 Codex 接管。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Codex to lead planning and tool calls in your terminal instead of Claude.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 分组装上 Codex 作为 agent 后端：由它做规划、调用工具与 MCP、在服务端保存会话历史并支持继续会话。凭证只存于 OneCLI 保险库，容器内读不到密钥。
howto.when: 当你按组执行 `ncl groups config update --provider codex` 切换后端，或把新建分组的默认后端设为 Codex 时接管。切换是操作者在主机上执行的动作。

say.text: 把 <group-id> 这组切到 codex，然后重启它
say.note: 该组改用 Codex 运行，记忆自动保留

say.text: 帮我给 Codex 跑一遍登录认证
say.note: 走订阅登录或 API key，存进保险库

say.text: 这组还有旧的 .seed.md 记忆，帮我迁移
say.note: 仅旧记忆未索引时才需要

howto.what_en: Installs Codex as a full agent backend for NanoClaw groups: it plans, calls tools and MCP, keeps server-side history and resumes sessions. Credentials live only in the OneCLI vault; nothing readable in the container.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you switch a group with `ncl groups config update --provider codex`, or default new groups to Codex. Switching is an operator action run from the host.

say_en.text: Switch group <group-id> to codex, then restart it
say_en.note: That group now runs on Codex; memory carries over

say_en.text: Run the Codex provider auth walk-through
say_en.note: Subscription login or API key, landed in the vault
